page_note: 这一页是 OECD《Employment Outlook 2024》第34页，主体为图 1.12「Real negotiated wages in selected OECD countries」，双面板柱状图叠加菱形标记，并配有长篇 Note/Source 与 StatLink 行。

heading.title: Real negotiated wages in selected OECD countries
heading.subtitle: Year-on-year percentage change in real negotiated wages (i.e. resulting from collective agreements)

figures.source_line: Source: OECD calculations based on national data on negotiated wages, see Annex Table 1.C.3.in (Araki et al., 2023[11]) for further details; and OECD (2024), “Prices: Consumer prices”, Main Economic Indicators (database), https://doi.org/10.1787/0f2e8000-en (accessed on 28 June 2024).

components.evidence: teal bars for "Q1 2024 or latest (↘)" with green diamond markers "Trough since Q4 2019" in the same panel
axis runs 6 down to -12; SWE and AUS bars sit below the zero line, all diamonds negative
the "Trough since Q4 2019" series is a single diamond glyph per country read on the same % axis
one legend box above both panels A and B carrying the two entries
legend box sits between the subtitle line and the panel titles "A. All sectors" / "B. Private sector"
"A. All sectors" and "B. Private sector" printed above each plot
two side-by-side panels of the same bar-plus-diamond chart
"Note: International comparability of data..." and "Source: OECD calculations based on national data..." under the plots
"StatLink" logo with "https://stat.link/g6dcje" at the bottom right of the figure box
axis labels read AUT, NLD, DEU, EA20, ITA, CAN, AUS, SWE, USA, FRA, BEL
a bare "%" printed above the top tick "6" on each panel
subtitle "Year-on-year percentage change in real negotiated wages" plus the "%" above the axis; ticks are bare numbers
the whole figure and preceding paragraph sit in a beige tinted bordered box

new_components.name: bar_to_marker_drop_line
new_components.evidence: a thin vertical line drops from each bar down to that country's trough diamond
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时须区分这条连接线只是引导线，不代表数量；柱高与菱形要分别对着同一 % 轴各读一次。

new_components.name: value_sorted_categories
new_components.evidence: legend reads "Q1 2024 or latest (↘)" and bars fall monotonically from AUT to SWE in both panels
new_components.why_it_matters: 类别顺序由柱值降序决定而非固定国别顺序，两面板顺序不同，跨面板按位置对齐会错行。

new_components.name: panel_specific_category_sets
new_components.evidence: panel A has 10 slots ending SWE; panel B has 13 including USA, USA (LS), FRA, BEL
new_components.why_it_matters: 面板列数不同，无法用一张共享类别表承载，必须每面板单独建行键。

new_components.name: variant_suffix_category_slot
new_components.evidence: "NLD" and "NLD (LS)" occupy separate slots; note defines "LS: wages including lump sums and/or special payments"
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一国家出现两次，仅靠国别码无法唯一定位某个值，必须连同 (LS) 后缀一起作为键。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，刻度每 2 个百分点一格，绘图区高度约 215 px 覆盖 6 到 -12 共 18 个单位，即约 12 px/单位。要把 -1.8 读到 5% 容差就是 ±0.09，仅约 1 px；2.0 的容差 ±0.1、1.5 的容差 ±0.075 同样在一两个像素内，而菱形本身直径就有 6~7 px，中心定位误差已超容差。相比之下标签虽需三个键（面板名 + 国别码含 (LS) 后缀 + 系列名），仍可写进表头，因此像素读数才是真正的瓶颈。
